progress.en: AI designs the shape and structure

progress.zh: 系留测试（真机固定在支架上扑动）
progress.en: Tethered test (the real bird flaps on a stand)

zh.title: 用真实飞行日志核对气动，降落改成带动力进近
zh.did: 找到西班牙 GRVC 团队公开的 E-Flap 扑翼机飞行日志，用它核对了我们的两翼气动模型：扑动频率预测误差 8%。R2 按新模型重算，24 次模拟飞行全部完成。
zh.problem: SmartBird 那个对照点还差 1.6 个百分点，按事先登记的标准仍判未通过；姿态模型因为数据是闭环飞行，做不成预测验证。
zh.next: 下一步是系留测试：把真机固定在支架上扑动，测拉力、电流和俯仰响应。

en.title: Aerodynamics checked against real flight logs; landing becomes a powered approach
en.did: We found the E-Flap flight logs published by the GRVC team in Seville and used them to check our two-wing aerodynamics model: flap frequency predicted within 8 %. R2 was re-run with the new model and completed all 24 simulated flights.
en.problem: The SmartBird reference point is still 1.6 points outside the pre-registered limit, so the model is formally marked as not passed; the attitude model could not be validated predictively because the logs are closed-loop flights.
en.next: Next: a tethered test. The real bird flaps on a stand while we measure thrust, current and pitch response.

zh.title: 修好高精度仿真核对里的一个错误
zh.did: 先用经典理论核对了 UVLM 高精度仿真本身，确认它可信；再发现上一次核对时输入的翼尖扭转错大了 3 倍，修正后重做。
zh.problem: 在 Eye-Bird 扑翼机的慢飞数据上，四种气动模型都把升力低估了约一半。
zh.next: 去找带控制输入的真实飞行数据。

en.title: Fixed a mistake in the high-fidelity simulation check
en.did: We first checked the UVLM high-fidelity solver itself against classical theory, then found that the previous check had fed it a wing-tip twist three times too large, fixed it and re-ran.
en.problem: On Eye-Bird ornithopter slow-flight data, four aerodynamics models all under-predicted lift by about half.
en.next: Find real flight data that includes the control inputs.

zh.title: 仿生鸟 R2：像一只真鸟
zh.did: 外形改成海鸥和鸢的比例：翼尖 5 根分开的初级飞羽，7 根羽毛的扇形尾。在仿真里完成了全部模拟飞行。
zh.problem: 像这样两只翅膀的扑翼机，几乎找不到公开的实测数据来核对气动。
zh.next: 找公开实测数据，并用高精度仿真交叉核对。

en.title: Bionic bird R2: shaped like a real bird
en.did: The shape now follows gull and kite proportions: five separated primary feathers at the wing tip and a fan tail of seven feathers. It completed every simulated flight.
en.problem: There is almost no public measured data for two-wing flappers like this to check the aerodynamics against.
en.next: Find public measurements and cross-check with a high-fidelity simulation.

zh.title: 第一版网站上线，开始设计第一只鸟 R1
zh.did: 网站和 Windows 安装包第一次上线；AI 开始设计第一只仿生鸟 R1，它随后在仿真里完成了 16 次模拟飞行。
zh.problem: 鸟的姿态模型连续三次验证没有通过。
zh.next: 把外形做得更像真鸟，并继续找数据验证姿态。

en.title: First website goes live; work starts on the first bird, R1
en.did: The website and the Windows installer went live for the first time; the AI started designing the first bionic bird, R1, which then completed 16 simulated flights.
en.problem: The bird's attitude model failed validation three times in a row.
en.next: Make the shape look more like a real bird and keep looking for data to validate the attitude.
